messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "people over 6 months old with perennial (year-round) allergies"
set: ["people over 6 months old with perennial (year-round) allergies", "children younger than 6 months old", "weight loss increases over 6 to 12 months", "allergies", "at least 6 years old", "perennial allergic rhinitis", "children younger than 6 years old", "severe allergies", "6 fewer patients 65 and over", "people 6 years and older", "pediatric patients less than 6 years old", "more common in people over 75", "people with asthma", "history of allergies", "medicine for allergies", "OCD in children aged 6 and over"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
